limits: All 37 primary public/own-Couple GET routes with available data plus one management-prefixed alias were measured on one retained synthetic booking. This is not 220-operation functional acceptance.
Three Vercel serial samples and one direct sample per route support only an indicative ranking. No p95, peak-load capacity, permanent error-free operation or formal SLA claim.
Longer pool acquisition wait reduces premature errors; it is not a query-speed optimization. A previously reproduced five-Staff-read burst still encounters transaction admission limits.
Pool caps/provider reserve/HTTP deadline/region/workers/providers/commands/source image were retained. No SQL-level timing instrumentation was enabled in this run.
Raw failed requests and exploratory profiles in the preceding investigation remain preserved. Exact driver cause/holder of every historical 500 is not established.
No new payment/provider callback, paid generation, email, business-data edit or fixture creation was invoked. The existing manual-payment status read cannot invoke VNPay reconciliation.
Normal session/security records and ordinary existing background workers continue. Fifteen selected business-table hashes are not a whole-database freeze.
PERF-13 and broader production NO_GO remain open; no provider acceptance gate is closed by this run.
